source_snapshot.items: RAS Enablement by Using Out-Of-Band Method
source_snapshot.procedure: Read EINJState on BMC OAM_0; if Disabled POST AMD ErrInjection Enable; verify Pending; reboot/warm reset; verify Enabled; source requests log clear.
source_snapshot.script: No script; five attended and thirty machine minutes; code is unique.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; read/enable through insecure Redfish curl, notes state change and project-defined final state.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; exact action/schema/TLS/target, owner approval, Pending/reset/Enabled transition, rollback and preserved logs.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly identifies partial/state-changing nature but omits the actual secure action body/task/reset/rollback contract.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly rejects hardcoded HTTP/curl-k/grep/plaintext patterns and requires discovered structured Redfish plus final-state governance.
historical_reviews.adjacent_context: The next Bad Page Avoidance case performs actual GPU error injection; enabling EINJState here does not authorize any fault injection beyond this configuration transition.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-01/03 require command/source fit; ED-07/08 preserve transition evidence; ED-17/18 protect configuration/credentials; ED-19 controls reset/recovery; ED-36/38 separate review from DUT verdict.

original_test_intent: Verify the approved AMD out-of-band RAS error-injection capability can transition the exact OAM resource from its baseline through Pending to Enabled after the required reset.
original_method: Discover and verify the exact Redfish resource/action, read structured baseline state, obtain approval, issue one schema-correct Enable only when required, observe action/task and Pending, perform the approved reset, verify Enabled and restore the owner-approved final state when required.
manual_activity: The owner approves the configuration change, exact reset class, workload impact and final-state/rollback disposition; an operator monitors independent recovery.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/BMC/OAM serial and Redfish service certificate/firmware/schema identity
Discovered Chassis/OAM resource and AMD ErrInjection action target
Exact Enable/Disable JSON payload, response/task model and legal state machine
Baseline, required target and post-test final-state policy
Approved reboot versus warm-reset semantics, boot deadline and workload drain
Independent recovery and preserved RAS/BMC/host evidence plan
safety_requirements: Use verified HTTPS/TLS and protected credentials; never hardcode target or use curl -k/plaintext secrets
Require explicit owner approval before POST or reset
Issue Enable only from an approved baseline and never inject an actual error in this case
Use one bounded action/reset attempt and stop on unexpected state, task failure or timeout
Preserve logs and raw Redfish responses; no clearing
Restore only through the documented Disable/rollback if final policy requires it
agent_execution_scope: Discover/verify exact resource/action/schema and collect baseline
After approval, issue one structured Enable and monitor task/state
Coordinate only the approved reset and verify same-target Enabled state
Perform approved rollback/final-state verification and package evidence
Make no fault injection, guessed POST, auto retry or PASS/FAIL verdict
engineer_actions: Approve exact action/schema, baseline/target/final state and reset class
Approve workload/recovery and supervise state-changing sequence
Review transition/final-state evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Reading/POSTing Redfish is conceptually correct, but hardcoded HTTP, curl -k, grep parsing, plaintext secret syntax and omitted action body/task/reset/rollback are unsafe/incomplete.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a verified HTTPS Redfish client to discover and GET structured EINJState, POST the approved action payload once, monitor task/Pending, perform approved reset, verify Enabled and then the approved final state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OOB method, OAM_0 context, Disabled/Pending/Enabled states, reboot-or-warm-reset requirement and 5/30-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: CRITICAL OWNER-GATED REDFISH EINJ STATE TRANSITION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat the action as an explicit state machine with exact target/schema, before/response/task/Pending/reset/Enabled/final checkpoints, raw hashes and bounded timeouts.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces insecure text scraping and incomplete POST with discovered structured Redfish, approval, task monitoring, recovery and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A single post-reset Enabled read cannot prove the correct resource/action changed, Pending occurred or the baseline/final policy was respected.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware implementations may use OEM resource paths and reset requirements. They must be discovered/approved for the exact revision rather than inferred from the hardcoded address.

project_override_considerations: A project may require Enabled to remain for later RAS tests or restore Disabled afterward; the choice must be explicit, auditable and tied to the downstream plan.
expected_evidence: Structured baseline GET and owner approval
Redacted POST response/task plus Pending observation
Approved reset class/timeline, same-target Enabled GET and host/BMC recovery
Final-state/rollback verification, preserved logs/no fault injection/no-auto-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria coherently require Disabled-to-Pending-to-Enabled transition. Reset choice and post-test final state are execution-governance inputs rather than contradictory requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Exact schema, approval, reset and rollback inputs gate the state-changing execution but do not prevent full static review.

review_improvement: Preserves the OOB enablement state machine while adding exact Redfish discovery, secure transport, bounded mutation, reset identity and final-state accountability.
independent_technical_reasoning: EINJState is configuration gating for later injection, not an injected fault itself. Observing Enabled after a reset is only credible if the exact OAM resource and action were verified and Pending was linked to the same action/task. Because leaving injection capability enabled may alter the safety posture of subsequent work, final-state policy is part of completion even though the source acceptance value is Enabled.
